\section[(dialogue)]{Things, clothes and tools — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R106-first-pass-things-clothes-and-tools}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for beans and a cucumber.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a blanket, a towel, soap, a toothbrush, toothpaste
  \item a comb, rubbish, a broom, a washing machine, an armchair
  \item a wardrobe, a sofa, a pot, a frying pan, a vase; a jar
  \item a bucket, a rope, a nail, a hammer, glue
  \item scissors, an alarm clock, a mobile phone, a camera, a ring
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A blanket? (\textbf{la coperta}.) A towel? (\textbf{l'asciugamano}.) Soap? (\textbf{il sapone}.) A toothbrush? (\textbf{lo spazzolino}.) Toothpaste? (\textbf{il dentifricio}.) A comb? (\textbf{il pettine}.) Rubbish? (\textbf{la spazzatura}.) A broom? (\textbf{la scopa}.) A washing machine? (\textbf{la lavatrice}.) An armchair? (\textbf{la poltrona}.) A wardrobe? (\textbf{l'armadio}.) A sofa? (\textbf{il divano}.) A pot? (\textbf{la pentola}.) A frying pan? (\textbf{la padella}.) A vase; a jar? (\textbf{il vaso}.) A bucket? (\textbf{il secchio}.) A rope? (\textbf{la corda}.) A nail? (\textbf{il chiodo}.) A hammer? (\textbf{il martello}.) Glue? (\textbf{la colla}.) Scissors? (\textbf{le forbici}.) An alarm clock? (\textbf{la sveglia}.) A mobile phone? (\textbf{il telefonino}.) A camera? (\textbf{la macchina fotografica}.) A ring? (\textbf{l'anello}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Food and drink — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R106-second-pass-food-and-drink}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a necklace and a candle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a necklace, a candle, a calendar, a letter, a message
  \item a rucksack, the world, people, a woman, the chest
  \item a jumper, a tie, gloves, a scarf, boots
  \item a skirt, a coat, shoes, socks, a blouse
  \item a hat, a jacket, a shirt, trousers, a dress; a suit
  \item beef, vegetables, a mushroom, beans, a cucumber
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A necklace? (\textbf{la collana}.) A candle? (\textbf{la candela}.) A calendar? (\textbf{il calendario}.) A letter? (\textbf{la lettera}.) A message? (\textbf{il messaggio}.) A rucksack? (\textbf{lo zaino}.) The world? (\textbf{il mondo}.) People? (\textbf{la gente}.) A woman? (\textbf{la donna}.) The chest? (\textbf{il petto}.) A jumper? (\textbf{il maglione}.) A tie? (\textbf{la cravatta}.) Gloves? (\textbf{i guanti}.) A scarf? (\textbf{la sciarpa}.) Boots? (\textbf{gli stivali}.) A skirt? (\textbf{la gonna}.) A coat? (\textbf{il cappotto}.) Shoes? (\textbf{le scarpe}.) Socks? (\textbf{i calzini}.) A blouse? (\textbf{la camicetta}.) A hat? (\textbf{il cappello}.) A jacket? (\textbf{la giacca}.) A shirt? (\textbf{la camicia}.) Trousers? (\textbf{i pantaloni}.) A dress; a suit? (\textbf{il vestito}.) Beef? (\textbf{il manzo}.) Vegetables? (\textbf{le verdure}.) A mushroom? (\textbf{il fungo}.) Beans? (\textbf{i fagioli}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{il cetriolo}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
